description.text: Premium Trainer Box MEGA, released on 1 August 2025 with Mega Brave and Mega Symphonia, the first expansions of the Mega Evolution series: ten packs of each and 172 cards of 51 kinds for building decks, with 12 of each of the eight basic Energy in a new design. Some are Scarlet & Violet cards reprinted. A card box, a coin, acrylic damage counters with a case and premium Poison and Burn markers came with it. This set holds the 43 kinds besides basic Energy.
